responsibility: Implements RTL loop unrolling and peeling transformations, including the analysis-driven rewriting of loop bodies after duplication. It decides and applies complete, runtime-count, and simple unrolling strategies for mostly innermost loops, manages induction-variable splitting and accumulator/variable expansion across copied iterations, rewrites copied and original insns to preserve semantics after duplication, and coordinates the loop-body optimizations that make unrolled RTL efficient. This file contains the transformation mechanics and copy-rewrite logic behind the public unroll_loops interface.
same_name_distinction: Contains the RTL loop-unrolling implementation itself, including unrolling/peeling decisions and the body-duplication rewrite machinery such as induction-variable splitting and accumulator expansion across copied iterations. Unlike gcc/loop-unroll.h, which only exposes the small public interface, this file carries the transformation algorithms and mechanics.
